questions.question_en: Which disaster-management description identifies Monitoring?
questions.question_te: పర్యవేక్షణ గురించి సరైన వివరణ/సంబంధం ఏది?
options: Timely actionable information about a potential or occurring threat
Estimating future hazard conditions and their uncertainty
Systematic observation of hazard-related conditions
Ensuring warnings reach and are understood by people at risk

ఈ వివరణ ముందస్తు అంచనా (Forecasting)కు చెందినది. పర్యవేక్షణకు సరైన సంబంధం: Systematic observation of hazard-related conditions.
Sensors and field reports evidence ఇస్తాయి. Systematic observation of hazard-related conditions.
ఈ వివరణ చివరి వ్యక్తికి సమాచారం (Last-mile communication)కు చెందినది. పర్యవేక్షణకు సరైన సంబంధం: Systematic observation of hazard-related conditions.

questions.question_en: An accurate forecast fails to reach a fishing community. What failed?

Warning communication and last-mile access
No part of preparedness
Proof all forecasting is meaningless
option_explanations: Tides do not explain communication failure.
Forecast-to-action requires reach, understanding and capacity.
Preparedness includes communication.
A communication gap does not invalidate the forecast science.

questions.question_en: Which recovery choice best illustrates Build Back Better?
questions.question_te: Build Back Betterకు best example ఏది?
options: Ignore affected people's access needs
Restore only a signboard
Rebuild with safer siting, resilient design and livelihood recovery
Reconstruct the same unsafe vulnerability without review
option_explanations: Inclusive access is essential.
A signboard does not restore functions.
Recovery should reduce future risk while restoring essential life systems.
This recreates underlying risk.
